description: This file defines the API controller class for the admin marketplace module in an OpenCart project. It includes methods for rendering the API settings page and for saving API credentials, including permission checks and validation.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for handling marketplace API configuration in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the API settings page with the current user token.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving API credentials with permission and input validation; returns success or error message as JSON.
